parameters.content:
## Retexia — Feeder Autopublish (gateway)

feeder.retexia.com/autopublish builds and watches ads; this workflow is its only door to **Meta**, **TikTok** and **WhatsApp**.

* One request = one allowed call. Paths not in the allow-list (Config) are refused.
* **No credentials** in this workflow: feeder.retexia.com sends the one key each call needs (admin → Settings → Integrations, Supabase Vault). Execution data isn't saved, so keys aren't kept.
* Every answer: `{ ok, status, body, usage }` (TikTok `code != 0` = not ok).
* The panel retries, waits for rate limits and turns errors into plain messages (feeder.ad_error_catalog).

Set in Vercel (panels): `FEEDER_ADS_N8N_URL` = this webhook's production URL, `FEEDER_ADS_N8N_KEY` = the Header Auth value.

API docs used: Marketing API (campaign, adset, adcreative, ad, advideos, adimages, page/leadgen_forms, search?type=adinterest); TikTok Business API v1.3 (campaign/adgroup/ad create + status/update, file/video/ad/upload, file/image/ad/upload, page/get, ad/get, ad/review_info, advertiser/info, identity/get).

**Auto comment** (feeder.retexia.com/auto-comment) uses `meta_page` too: read posts / ads with comments, reply, hide, and private replies, all with the Page's own token.

Action `ai`: one OpenAI call for Auto comment (credential **OpenAI API key**, the same one Lingo Feeder uses).
